measurements.scope: Approximate 6,000 km Humboldt Current belt from southern Chile toward northern Peru and the Galápagos, reported in an embedded Purca et al. manuscript in Purca Cuicapusa's 2005 thesis. This is a broad eastern South Pacific current-system extent, not a measured core streamline or the Peru Coastal Current alone; the manuscript separately describes its 1,000 km Peru study area.
measurements.source_locator: PDF page 65, embedded Purca et al. manuscript, Introduction opening paragraph (ca. 6,000 km belt); PDF page 66 distinguishes its 1,000 km Peru study area

map_features.note: Approximate editorial locator points place a name in a recognizable region on the OSW equirectangular map. Points are neither observed cores nor endpoints or length measurements.
